spanish: Varón, a su madre y a su padre temerán, y mis shabats guardarán; yo Jehová su Dios.

findings.issue: שַׁבְּתֹתַי is a common noun (plural + 1cs “my”), not a proper name; “shabats” leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.

notes: 2mp yiqtol as temerán/guardarán, יהוה as Jehová, and אלהים as Dios stay licensed; no unmarked copula.
